blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Maynilad Water Services Inc. (Maynilad) upgrades its La Mesa water treatment facilities to strengthen its preparations for the strong El Niño phenomenon in the coming months and reduce its reliance on the Angat-Ipo Dam, its primary source of raw water. The upgrades are designed to help the company manage changes in raw water quality, recover more water during treatment, and maintain a stable supply even when water availability becomes more challenging, Maynilad head of corporate communications Jennifer Rufo said. “The upgrades allow us to better manage more variable raw water conditions, recover more of the water already in […]...
